body: ## Correction — the core IDOR is already fixed on current `main` (#2970); this issue was filed against stale code While starting the fix I read the current code and found the E4 verification had run against a **pre-#2970 snapshot**. On `main` today (`929efdf`), both download routes are RLS-gated. Retracting the P1 framing: **What's actually enforced now** (`storage-service-plugin.ts:442-496` `buildFileReadAuthorizer`, wired at `:257`; gate at `storage-routes.ts:88-114`, applied by BOTH `/files/:fileId` `:530` and `/files/:fileId/url` `:491`): - For `scope === 'attachments'`, non-`public_read` files: resolves the caller's RLS context from the request; **no session → 401** (`unauthenticated`); **owner → allow**; otherwise loads the `sys_attachment` links and **allows only if the caller can see a parent record under their OWN RLS** (`context: authz`), else **403**; **fail-closed** on any error. - The check is **live per download**, so revoking the `sys_attachment` share now **does** revoke byte access — contradicting my "survives revocation" claim. So the "any authenticated user reads any attachment by fileId" IDOR is **closed** for attachment files. My original report reflected the older path that served bytes on a bare `status==='committed'` check. **Genuine residuals (smaller, partly by-design) — the only things left to decide:** 1. **Non-`attachments`-scope files** (avatars, org logos, `scope:'user'`) keep a **stable anonymous capability URL** — `authorizeDownload` early-returns for `scope !== 'attachments'` (`storage-routes.ts:93`). This is a **deliberate #2970 decision** (these are embedded in ``/`` which can't carry a bearer token) and is already flagged as a tracked follow-up in the code (`:26-27`). Whether record field-files that are *not* attachments-scope need gating is a threat-model call — not the reported IDOR. 2. **Signed tokens aren't caller-bound** (`{k,exp,op}`) — but they're now only minted **after** the authorization passes and are short-lived (`downloadTtl` 300s). A leaked token is replayable only within its TTL. Minor. **Recommendation:** close this as **resolved by #2970**, or relabel to **P3** and narrow the title to residual #1 (non-attachments-scope anonymous capability URLs) if the team wants that hardened. Either way it is not a live P1. I'll leave the state change to a maintainer. _(Filed from the ADR-0096 E4 sweep; corrected after reading current `main`. The E4 finding stands as "verified — already remediated," which is itself a good D4 outcome: the storage surface has a caller-scoped download proof.)_ --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
